parts:
Hi,

the g2 matrix construction in dirichlet.fem was incorrect (the
internal code calculated
K %*% "inverse of c0" %*% K,
where K_ij = G_ij - <\psi_i, \partial_n \psi_j>, but the needed matrix was
t(K) %*% "inverse of c0" %*% K

The attached code has been corrected

Finn

messages.author: afb003e064114795

...and on further reflection, the differences in the matrices was
possibly only on the boundary nodes that are removed, so the new code
may actually give identical results.

Finn
